data.title: Pilot Salutes Veterans with Free Meals and Funds for Career Development
data.description: In Knoxville, Tennessee, Pilot is showing appreciation for veterans and active-duty service members by offering them a complimentary meal on Veterans Day. In addition, Pilot encourages customers to round up their purchases to support veterans in transitioning to civilian careers. Through Pilot's Miles of Good initiative, the yearly fundraising drive complements the organization's partnership with the Call of Duty Endowment. This collaboration aims to assist veterans in leveraging their expertise and backgrounds for successful avenues in high-quality employment post their military service.

data.title: THE 9TH BUSINESS CARE INTERNATIONAL AWARD BRINGS ITALIAN BUSINESS, SCIENCE AND CULTURE TO NYC'S CONSULATE GENERAL OF ITALY ON NOVEMBER 18-19
data.description: 11 distinguished individuals were recognized with "The Award of Awards" in New York on October 23, 2026. Among these honorees were an airline executive, a yacht manufacturer, a cardiologist, and renowned journalists. The event celebrated leaders excelling in various fields, including those in charge of flying Italy's flag carrier over the Atlantic and constructing top-tier superyachts. The award ceremony marked a significant return to New York with these remarkable individuals receiving recognition for their outstanding contributions in their respective industries.
